official_observations.note: Complete official roots and recursively listed children; not exact CN timing calibration.

internal_policy: Coghammer is wholly unregistered pending an actual public one-physical-target keyword-group random operation. Full current and historical identity rows remain evidence.

Ominous uses native ChooseOneSpec: one SPELL DamageBatch over current active minions, or captured original damaged minion +2/+2 through public predicate. Required combined branch uses damaged-at-acceptance target, damage then captured buff; exact CN combined target policy remains uncalibrated.
Sleep uses native summon or enemy-minion destruction branch; required combined body summons two Night Terrors then destroys original captured enemy. Exact CN combined order remains local.
Overgrown Horror reduces only actually held minions with real Dark Gift attachments, using CardReference and ModifyStoredCost(-2); ordinary quote/payment floor stays public.
Wasp listens to original positive damage_dealt, including accepted lethal notification, then ordinary AddToHand of the exact 1-Cost Stinger; no survival requirement or damage-amount multiplier.
Stinger has ordinary character target, a two-damage SPELL packet then one attributed existing Grub summon; Infestation gets two copies of the same full Stinger.
Official full faces/children support identity and text, not exact CN timing or formal Standard pool closure.
